name: Rema Schneider
summary: In Stormwind City, Rema Schneider keeps trade moving from the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop. A human citizen, she often helps local shopkeepers and artisans with deliveries.

sections.title: Shopkeeper of the Canals
sections.body: Rema Schneider manages daily trade from the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop. The shop lies just west of the stone bridge into Cathedral Square, beside Stormwind's canals. Cloth and finished garments pass between local craftsmen, and Rema depends on couriers to carry supplies from one workshop to another.

faq.answer: Rema Schneider works inside the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop in Stormwind City. It sits along the Canals, just west of the bridge into Cathedral Square.

faq.q: What role does Rema play in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Rema coordinates local trade errands, supply packages, and resupply orders between merchants and craftspeople across Stormwind.
No. Rema works from the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop and handles shipments of tailor goods. She is neither a profession trainer nor a primary vendor.

angles.text: Rema works inside the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, part of Stormwind's everyday clothworking trade.
As a traveler or new recruit in Stormwind, you may carry simple deliveries for Rema while finding your way around the capital.
